items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I worked out there with him, me, Jack Carey, Lil' Lawrence, and Emil Raleigh. It was four pieces, no saxophone.

ctx.x: Two or three numbers, then he'd go over there.

I worked out there with him, me, Jack Carey, Lil' Lawrence, and Emil Raleigh. It was four pieces, no saxophone. Just trombone, cornet, and banjo, and drum. At that time they had no guitar. It wasn't used to no guitar, I mean at that time, banjo. Old man Jack Carey, yeah sure, tall, slim, he was living in Seussberry.
Nobody would ever mention him much. Yeah, he shouldn't be mentioned though. I was small, I couldn't have a tie in this thing.
